records.notes: Different datasets and protocol.

records.title: DCdetector: Dual Attention Contrastive Representation Learning for Time Series Anomaly Detection
records.model: Uses multi-scale dual attention and pure contrastive learning rather than reconstruction.
records.limitations: Reported rankings can depend on evaluation conventions; model is not needed to answer the current causal preprocessing question.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Modern non-reconstruction baseline for discussion, not immediate implementation.
records.notes: Different datasets and evaluation conventions.

records.title: TimeSeriesBench: An Industrial-Grade Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection Models
records.model: Evaluates unified-model, unseen-series, and practical metric settings across more than 168 configurations.
records.limitations: Software-system time series and preprint status; not a direct FD002 comparison.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Supports unseen-engine evaluation, operational constraints, and resisting per-series overfitting.
records.notes: Different domains and evaluation units.

records.title: TSB-UAD: An End-to-End Benchmark Suite for Univariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection
records.model: Standardizes many datasets and methods in a reproducible end-to-end benchmark.
records.limitations: Univariate benchmark; FD002 is multivariate and engine-grouped.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Benchmark-design precedent and evidence that reproducibility infrastructure is part of the contribution.
records.notes: Different benchmark scope.

records.title: TimeEval: A Benchmarking Toolkit for Time Series Anomaly Detection Algorithms
records.authors: Phillip Wenig; Sebastian Schmidl; Thorsten Papenbrock
records.model: Provides an extensible automated framework for comparable detector, dataset, runtime, and metric experiments.
records.limitations: A toolkit does not solve FD002 label ambiguity or define engine-level operational metrics.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Motivates versioned configs, common interfaces, and repeatable experiment execution.
records.notes: Tooling paper.

records.title: Evaluating Real-time Anomaly Detection Algorithms: The Numenta Anomaly Benchmark
records.model: Defines time-sensitive anomaly windows and rewards early detection while penalizing false positives.
records.limitations: Univariate streaming benchmark and application-weighted score are not directly transferable.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Supports explicit lead-time and false-alert trade-offs instead of F1 alone.
records.notes: Different scoring function and data.

records.title: Local Evaluation of Time Series Anomaly Detection Algorithms
records.model: Introduces affiliation precision/recall using distances between predicted and true event sets with local interpretation.
records.limitations: Still requires meaningful labeled event ranges, which FD002 does not provide directly.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Candidate event-level sensitivity metric after proxy intervals are explicitly declared.
records.notes: Defines metrics rather than a comparable detector.

records.title: PATE: Proximity-Aware Time Series Anomaly Evaluation
records.model: Weights early and delayed detections using buffer zones and provides proximity-aware area under precision-recall.
records.limitations: Parameters and interval semantics must be fixed before seeing test results.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Optional temporal metric for onset sensitivity and early-warning analysis.
records.notes: Defines an evaluation measure.

records.title: Do You Know Existing Accuracy Metrics Overrate Time-Series Anomaly Detections?
records.model: Shows common range and point-adjusted metrics can overrate imprecise detections; proposes enhanced temporal precision/recall.
records.limitations: No metric removes the need to define the operational meaning of an event.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Reinforces the ban on point-adjusted headline F1 and need for multiple transparent metrics.
records.notes: Evaluation-method paper.

records.title: Position: Quo Vadis, Unsupervised Time Series Anomaly Detection?
records.model: Critiques flawed metrics, inconsistent benchmark practices, and weak justification for deep architectural complexity.
records.limitations: Position paper rather than a detector benchmark; conclusions should guide protocol, not replace evidence.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Supports simple strong controls, ablation-driven complexity, and claim restraint.
records.notes: Methodological critique.

records.title: Optimal Detection of Changepoints With a Linear Computational Cost
records.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
records.model: Introduces PELT, an exact penalized segmentation algorithm with linear expected cost under stated conditions.
records.limitations: Offline segmentation gives an estimated statistical change, not physical degradation ground truth.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Transparent auxiliary onset-sensitivity baseline on engine-level score trajectories.
records.notes: Onset-estimation method.

records.title: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
records.model: Maintains a posterior over run length to infer the most recent generative-parameter change online.
records.limitations: Requires a predictive model and hazard prior; estimated change remains model-dependent.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Future online onset comparator, not primary evaluation ground truth.
records.notes: Change-detection method.

records.title: Selective Review of Offline Change Point Detection Methods
records.model: Organizes methods by cost function, search, and constraint; links theory to the ruptures implementation.
records.limitations: A broad review; method selection and calibration remain application-specific.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Decision guide for any auxiliary change-point onset analysis.
records.notes: Review paper.

records.title: Change-Point Detection in Time-Series Data by Relative Density-Ratio Estimation
records.model: Estimates relative Pearson divergence directly between neighboring windows without separately estimating densities.
records.limitations: Window and regularization choices affect onset; not a true FD002 label.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Nonparametric auxiliary onset method for sensitivity checks.
records.notes: Change-point method.

records.title: Kernel Change-Point Detection
records.model: Uses kernel representations and model selection to find distributional changes beyond mean shifts.
records.limitations: Computational and kernel-selection sensitivity; estimated changes are not physical labels.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Possible non-linear onset comparator after the primary fixed-proxy analysis.
records.notes: Change-point method.

records.title: Control Chart Tests Based on Geometric Moving Averages
records.model: Foundational exponentially/geometrically weighted moving-average monitoring for small process shifts.
records.limitations: Classical assumptions do not automatically hold for autocorrelated learned anomaly scores.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Foundational citation and motivation for EWMA ablation, not proof that EWMA improves FD002.
records.notes: Foundational method.

records.title: Continuous Inspection Schemes
records.model: Introduces cumulative-sum inspection logic for persistent sequential shifts.
records.limitations: CUSUM requires a declared in-control distribution and tuning for score dependence.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Comparator to persistence/EWMA if threshold study budget permits.
records.notes: Foundational method.

records.title: Learning from Time-Changing Data with Adaptive Windowing
records.venue: SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
records.model: ADWIN adapts the window length from statistically detected changes rather than a fixed update horizon.
records.limitations: Blind adaptation can still learn degradation; detector updates need a healthy-state gate.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Evidence for explicit drift logic if online recalibration is studied later.
records.notes: Drift method.

records.title: A Survey on Concept Drift Adaptation
records.model: Taxonomizes drift detection, adaptation strategies, evaluation, and application settings.
records.limitations: Concept drift is not identical to irreversible degradation and supervised framing often differs.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Frames safe adaptation as a separate research problem rather than default threshold updating.
records.notes: Review paper.

records.title: Why Should I Trust You?: Explaining the Predictions of Any Classifier
records.model: Introduces LIME, fitting an interpretable local surrogate around an individual prediction.
records.limitations: Local surrogate fidelity and perturbation design are crucial, especially for correlated sequences.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Supports explicit fidelity checks and cautions against relabeling heuristics as explanations.
records.notes: Explanation method.

records.title: Axiomatic Attribution for Deep Networks
records.model: Introduces Integrated Gradients using sensitivity and implementation-invariance axioms.
records.limitations: Attributions depend on the baseline and explain a scalar model output, not necessarily a causal fault.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Possible native attribution for the frozen differentiable anomaly score after reconstruction contributions.
records.notes: Explanation method.

records.title: Learning Important Features Through Propagating Activation Differences
records.model: DeepLIFT decomposes output differences from a reference activation into feature contributions.
records.limitations: Reference choice and network operation rules affect interpretation.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Secondary native-gradient-style explainer if a scalar score explanation is needed.
records.notes: Explanation method.

records.title: TimeSHAP: Explaining Recurrent Models through Sequence Perturbations
records.model: Extends KernelSHAP to feature-, event-, and cell-level attributions with sequence pruning.
records.limitations: Computational cost, perturbation realism, and correlated sensor-time inputs can weaken fidelity.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Most relevant optional SHAP-family method for an LSTM, after native contribution maps are validated.
records.notes: Explanation method.

records.title: Explaining Anomalies Detected by Autoencoders Using SHAP
records.learning_setting: unsupervised or method-dependent; exact training supervision NR
records.model: Uses KernelSHAP around an autoencoder anomaly score to show features increasing or offsetting anomalousness.
records.limitations: Perturbations and surrogate fidelity must be validated; explanations are not root-cause proof.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Direct precedent for optional AE-SHAP after removing the current placeholder payload.
records.notes: Explanation method.

records.title: Feature Bagging for Outlier Detection
records.model: Combines outlier detectors trained on random feature subsets to improve robustness in noisy high dimensions.
records.limitations: Random sensor subsets may destroy important temporal/physical dependencies.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Historical ensemble precedent; supports ablation before assuming fusion helps.
records.notes: Different datasets and representations.

records.title: LSCP: Locally Selective Combination in Parallel Outlier Ensembles
records.venue: SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
records.model: Selects locally competent base outlier detectors before combining their scores.
records.limitations: Competence estimation without ground truth adds complexity and possible overfitting.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Evidence that fusion is a model-selection problem, not a free performance gain.
records.notes: Different data and selection protocol.

records.title: SUOD: Accelerating Large-Scale Unsupervised Heterogeneous Outlier Detection
records.model: Accelerates many heterogeneous detectors using data reduction, model approximation, and balanced scheduling.
records.limitations: An acceleration system does not establish that an ensemble improves scientific validity.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Scaling option only if many detector variants are later justified.
records.notes: Different goal and datasets.

records.title: Interpreting and Unifying Outlier Scores
records.venue: SIAM International Conference on Data Mining
records.model: Maps heterogeneous arbitrary outlier factors to a common interpretable range before comparison or combination.
records.limitations: Probability-like normalization is model-based and not guaranteed to be calibrated probability.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Direct support for frozen training-fitted score calibration before any fusion.
records.notes: Score-transformation method.

records.title: Explainable Deep One-Class Classification
records.model: FCDD makes a fully convolutional one-class output map serve directly as an anomaly explanation map.
records.limitations: Image-specific architecture; not directly applicable to 30-by-21 sensor sequences.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Evidence that explanation can be native to the detector rather than a mislabeled post-hoc heuristic.
records.notes: Different modality.

records.title: On the Evaluation of Unsupervised Outlier Detection: Measures, Datasets, and an Empirical Study
records.model: Studies evaluation measures, benchmark construction, contamination, and instability across many outlier detectors.
records.limitations: Mostly tabular outlier settings; temporal grouping and early warning require additional metrics.
records.relevance_to_methodology: Supports careful benchmark construction and multiple strong classical controls.
records.notes: Different datasets and evaluation units.
